title: Tavern 0.6.194: reduce glyph startup work and prepare the registry cooperatively
public_notes_inline: Writing boards read the same glyph widths directly without building full numeric arrays during startup. Native scheduler jobs prepare the initial registry before exposing it or publishing the Cookery chapter; guide packets are paced at two per tick. Expected NOT_CUP rejections retain diagnostics and one player hint without server warning spam. Includes the exact Grilling 0.2.15 host SDK contract. Full-family saved-world and actual client acceptance remain pending.
